## Pull request overview

This PR adds a changeset file to trigger a patch release for the auto-detect persistence feature introduced in PR #818. The changeset correctly identifies `@objectstack/spec` for a patch version bump, which will cascade to all 35 packages in the monorepo due to the fixed versioning configuration.

**Changes:**
- Adds `.changeset/patch-release.md` documenting the memory driver auto-detect persistence feature
